## Pass / change summary

Describe the pass objective, implementation, and any intentionally deferred work.

## Verification

- [ ] Required local/unit/browser tests pass
- [ ] Relevant visual QA artifacts inspected
- [ ] Classic rules behavior remains source-grounded
- [ ] Pass 10.3 geometry authority preserved unless this PR explicitly supersedes it
- [ ] Tap/drag/action-path parity preserved where applicable
- [ ] Interruption/save/restore behavior checked where applicable

## Continuity — required before merge

- [ ] `CONTINUITY.md` read before implementation
- [ ] `FUTURE_CONTINUITY.md` read before implementation when roadmap sequencing/scope is relevant
- [ ] `CONTINUITY.md` updated with this pass status, branch/PR/SHAs, implementation, QA, debt, and exact next handoff
- [ ] Top continuity snapshot updated if the completed/next milestone changed
- [ ] `FUTURE_CONTINUITY.md` updated if future sequencing or established roadmap requirements intentionally changed
- [ ] Any superseded project decision is recorded explicitly instead of silently deleting history

> A pass is not continuity-complete until the running `CONTINUITY.md` is updated. Future roadmap changes must also be reflected in `FUTURE_CONTINUITY.md` rather than left only in chat history.
